title: Complete Israeli-identity and anti-Israel opinion studies
description:
As a reader, I want two separately preregistered studies: a nationality-only decision-treatment test for an Israeli person, and a source-grounded direct-opinion test for anti-Israel claims.

Feature: separate Israeli-identity and anti-Israel-claim measurement
  Scenario: pre-registration precedes inference
    Given each study commits its cues or claims, controls, scoring, and refusal handling before model inference
    When models are run
    Then results describe model behavior, not people or political positions

No paid hosted engine runs without approved pricing.
